owner_statements: I have permission for raw pbs redistribution.
Don't require me to record and apply the terms, just proceed with allowing it.
scope: Raw PBS schedule PDFs and machine-readable schedule packages, including historical editions and source-identified archived variants.
preservation_controls: Preserve original bytes, notices, attribution and source disclaimers.
Record source URL, retrieval evidence, edition identity, size and checksum.
Keep source payloads out of the software Git repository; use governed external archive storage.
Do not apply the software Apache-2.0 licence to PBS payloads.
